allocation_end_valid.name: allocation_end_valid
allocation_end_valid.value: ("payment_allocations"."ended_on" is null and "payment_allocations"."ended_by" is null) or ("payment_allocations"."ended_on" is not null and "payment_allocations"."ended_by" is not null and "payment_allocations"."ended_on" >= "payment_allocations"."accounting_date")

trade_party_amount_range.name: trade_party_amount_range
trade_party_amount_range.value:
("invoices"."party_amount" is null or "invoices"."party_amount" between 0 and "invoices"."total") and
    ("invoices"."applied_credit" is null or ("invoices"."party_amount" is not null and "invoices"."applied_credit" between 0 and "invoices"."party_amount"))

posted_invoice_metadata.name: posted_invoice_metadata
posted_invoice_metadata.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'posted' or ("invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."voucher_id" is not null)

valid_stock_move.name: valid_stock_move
valid_stock_move.value:
"stock_movements"."unit_cost" >= 0 and
    (("stock_movements"."signed_quantity" = 0 and "stock_movements"."signed_value" <> 0 and "stock_movements"."movement_kind" = 'valuation') or
    ("stock_movements"."signed_quantity" <> 0 and ("stock_movements"."signed_value" = 0 or sign("stock_movements"."signed_value") = sign("stock_movements"."signed_quantity"))))

voucher_document_link.name: voucher_document_link
voucher_document_link.value:
("voucher_documents"."source" = 'manual' and "voucher_documents"."source_id" is null and "voucher_documents"."opening_party_id" is null and "voucher_documents"."opening_account_id" is null)
    or ("voucher_documents"."source" = 'opening' and "voucher_documents"."type" = 'opening' and "voucher_documents"."source_id" is null and num_nonnulls("voucher_documents"."opening_party_id", "voucher_documents"."opening_account_id") = 1)
    or ("voucher_documents"."source" in ('invoice', 'inventory_adjustment') and "voucher_documents"."source_id" is not null and "voucher_documents"."opening_party_id" is null and "voucher_documents"."opening_account_id" is null)

posted_document_voucher.name: posted_document_voucher
posted_document_voucher.value: "voucher_documents"."status" <> 'posted' or ("voucher_documents"."current_voucher_id" is not null and "voucher_documents"."number" is not null and "voucher_documents"."draft" is null)

draft_document_payload.name: draft_document_payload
draft_document_payload.value: "voucher_documents"."status" <> 'draft' or ("voucher_documents"."draft" is not null and "voucher_documents"."current_voucher_id" is null)

posted_voucher_metadata.name: posted_voucher_metadata
posted_voucher_metadata.value: "vouchers"."status" <> 'posted' or ("vouchers"."number" is not null and "vouchers"."posted_at" is not null)
